name: required-helper-examples
goal: Every public callable has committed executable examples and missing examples fail registry checks

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Require per-callable committed usage examples, enforce through registry checks, preserve historical gaps and fill all ten public helpers.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing optional-document and helper index tests never required examples; strengthened them plus callable detail browser cases and generated guidance assertions.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: be5e282f fails unchanged CLI, generator, documentation and desktop callable assertions: Callable examples are required. Recorded red checkpoint preserved in Git evidence.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: 132d82b5 stores 32 executable examples across all ten public Helpers, preserves them through indexing, selects callable-specific examples and enforces registry and generated guidance requirements.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: 132d82b5 passes the identical CLI, documentation, generated-guidance and desktop callable command in the same environment. Git regression proof links the checkpoints; fresh test-owned screenshots inspected.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
